## Kimi K3.1 Pro API

Kimi K3.1 Pro is a large language model by Moonshot AI, available on the Venice API as `kimi-k3-1-pro`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Kimi K3.1 Pro is Moonshot AI's flagship multimodal reasoning model and the post-trained successor to Kimi K3, with a 1M-token context window. It is built for long-horizon coding, agentic workflows, financial research, and 3D modeling through CAD code.

### Kimi K3.1 Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kimi-k3-1-pro` | Standard | Private | $2.00 / $10.00 per 1M |

### Kimi K3.1 Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Moonshot AI |
| Released | Oct 23, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, low, high, max |

### How to use the Kimi K3.1 Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "kimi-k3-1-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kimi-k3-1-pro",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "max"
  }'
```
